principle_violations.reason: The `Order` class handles both order and payment statuses, violating the SRP. Each payment processor prints transaction details and modifies the order status directly.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the order item handling and status update logic from the payment processing logic. Payment processors should not directly modify the order's status.

principle_violations.reason: Currently each payment processor directly sets the order status. This requires modification if the order status update logic changes.
principle_violations.suggestion: Introduce a method in the order class to handle status updates, thereby closing it to modifications affecting each payment processor if the logic changes.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
